purpose: Define the strategy-agnostic precondition gate that a future Setup candidate must pass before any Setup-specific logic may treat it as an AI-Core candidate.

inputs.U_layer: V2.8.3 PASS PIT date authority and its exact universe snapshot for signal date D
inputs.E_layer: V2.8.4 effective E-state resolver for the same canonical_security_id and signal date D

result_states.PASS_DRY_AI_CORE_CANDIDATE: U(D) membership is PASS and E(D)=ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE. This authorizes only downstream dry Setup evaluation.
result_states.BLOCK_NO_PIT_U_AUTHORITY: No frozen PASS PIT universe authority exists for D.
result_states.BLOCK_U_AUTHORITY: The D authority or snapshot fails integrity/date/schema checks.
result_states.BLOCK_NOT_IN_U_D: Security is not a member of the official PIT universe for D.

problem_elimination.avoid: Do not mix price/factor logic into U/E eligibility.
problem_elimination.absorb: Reuse the already frozen V2.8.3 PIT U authority and V2.8.4 E-state resolver.
problem_elimination.substitute: Expose one deterministic precondition function for future Setup implementations.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Reuse sparse E effective-event ledger and per-date PIT universe snapshot.
problem_elimination.optimize: One security/date membership lookup plus one E-state lookup.

forbidden: No Setup strategy definition or setup_id generation.
No append to First60 candidate ledger.
No use of V2.7.31 static universe as a substitute for missing U(D).
